verify.seoDescription: Check a Max-Morrys certificate code. No account, no sign-up: the page answers one code, and nothing else.
verify.lede: Paste the code printed on the document. No account needed, and nothing is recorded about whoever is checking.
verify.codeHint: The code is on the document: “MM-” followed by ten characters. Extra spaces and dashes are ignored.
verify.emptyError: Enter the code printed on the document.
verify.idleTitle: The result will show up here
verify.idleBody: Holder, course, issue date and code. Nothing else: the page doesn't lead back to any account.
verify.validIssuer: Issued by Max-Morrys, MY ONOMA SARL, Dakar.
verify.notFoundBody: This code doesn't match anything issued. Check what you typed before concluding anything — one character off is enough. If the document still looks genuine to you, write to me.
verify.failedBody: The request never reached the server. This is NOT an answer about the certificate: try again in a moment, or write to me if it keeps happening.
verify.truthTitle: What this page doesn't let you do
verify.truthBody: It doesn't list the certificates issued, and it doesn't lead back to an account. It answers one code, and one only. That's what makes it usable by an employer without exposing the holders.
